Schema: customers (id BIGINT, country_code VARCHAR, account_status VARCHAR, balance NUMERIC, updated_at TIMESTAMP)

```

### Recommended Index
```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_customers_status_balance ON customers (country_code, account_status, balance DESC);
```
